propositions: Fourteen call sites in src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with mode=structured, output_schema, and execution_mode=single_turn, creating maintainability and correctness risk through copy-paste duplication.

RunRequest's contract requires single_turn requests to carry both mode=structured and output_schema, but this invariant is neither enforced nor visible, with the constraint re-asserted manually at each site.

Bounding decisions for lowering-only seams (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s) are undeclared at thirteen of fourteen sites, making unbounded requests indistinguishable from deliberately-unbounded ones.

A shared builder SingleTurnBounds dataclass with required non-defaulted fields and RunRequest.for_structured classmethod will enforce the single-turn structured contract and make bounding decisions explicit and greppable at all call sites.

The existing site oracle in test_subcall_class_selection.py will become incomplete after adoption because it matches only RunRequest(...) calls and not the new RunRequest.for_structured(...) classmethod, requiring its AST matcher to recognize both forms.
